objective: Increase rising precision by causal terminal-standing modeling, retaining V4 event detections and seated false-positive rate; preserve all V3 walking/bending/falling outputs.
legacy: All V4 train remains train; all V4 dev and former test are development/regression, including Telkom14/15. Never call these independent V5 tests.

new_rgb_test.clips: both before/after, fixed first20s, native30fps, no model-based selection

real_slow_source.selection: Three available recordings with author-metric mean ascent>=2s, plus three available 1.77-1.92s recordings. YcE3Tlrl, zN0O4jLu, Ydhtzejw are absent from author archive and are excluded for availability only before model predictions. Natural timestamps; no speed augmentation. Explicit subject IDs from author code.
real_slow_source.labels: Manual review of skeleton contact sheets; not clinical slow diagnosis. Frames retain OpenPose confidence.
real_slow_source.REMAP: Public files still return empty response; replaced by accessible Stanford source.
real_slow_source.caveat: Author STS duration includes preparatory dwell; visible lift alone is generally <1.5s here. These are real slower complete transitions, not clinical bradykinetic ascent. Extra automatic slow candidates rejected before inference: visual review found camera motion/partial poses or merged cycles. No new model predictions used.
real_slow_source.identity_limit: Author anonymized subject IDs used; no claim of independently verified identity across source recordings. Primary new-person test is Telkom1/2/3. Exact duplicate skeletons prohibited across splits.

selection: Development only. Prefer rising precision/F1 improvement with V4 matched rising event hit count unchanged, seated false rises no higher, walking/bending/falling exact preservation. Report any remaining recall trade-off, use same source-clock sampling everywhere.
freeze: Freeze model, manifest, protocol and inference sources before new test predictions. No tuning on test.
metrics: standing false rise and exit lag
limits: New RGB tests same side-view setup, publisher processed images. Agent visual labels without independent human adjudication. REMAP is skeleton-input component evaluation, not RGB detection accuracy. No overhead validation.
